project.boundarySource: Curated visitor envelope derived from the OpenStreetMap settlement point, with adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 2 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 25 of 25 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Alberbury qualifies as a local detour through Alberbury Castle: tower keep castle 70m south west of the Church of St Michael and All Angels and ALBERBURY CASTLE, REMAINS OF. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Alberbury: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Alberbury offers Alberbury Castle: tower keep castle 70m south west of the Church of St Michael and All Angels, ALBERBURY CASTLE, REMAINS OF, Standing cross in the churchyard of St Michael and All Angels' Church within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.
